name: Analyze combat mechanics and character builds in games
description: Users requested detailed analysis, identification, and listing of specific combat mechanics, character builds, moves, and game objects within various video games and tabletop role-playing games. These queries focused on technical details such as move names, stat calculations, item synergies, and specific character capabilities rather than general lore or plot summaries.
